Short title and commencement

SINDH COAL AUTHORITY
SINDH COAL
AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1993
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th May, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(14)/2002,
dated 11‑5‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is, hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 7 of Sindh Act No. VI of 1994

SINDH COAL AUTHORITY
SINDH COAL
AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1993
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th May, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(14)/2002,
dated 11‑5‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is, hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 7 of
Sindh Act No. VI of 1994.‑‑‑In the Sindh Coal Authority
Act, 1993, hereinafter referred to be the said Act, in section 7, in subsection
(3), for the word "Industries", the word "Mines" shall be
substituted.

Amendment of section 10 of Sindh Act No. VI of 1994

3. Amendment of section 10 of
Sindh Act No. VI of 1994.‑‑‑In the said Act, in section
10 in subsections (1) and (3), for the word "Government", the word
"Authority" shall be substituted.
